preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some MiniDOGE tokens to initiate the attack
swapAndLiquifyEnabled must be true (default is false, but owner may enable it)
Contract must have accumulated enough tokens (minimumTokensBeforeSwap = 200000 * 10**6 * 10**9) from fees to trigger swap

exploit_hint: Deploy a malicious contract that implements a reentrancy attack in its fallback/receive function. The attack exploits the transferToAddressETH() function which uses recipient.transfer(amount) after swapping tokens for ETH. When the contract calls transferToAddressETH(marketingAddress, ...), if marketingAddress is a malicious contract, it can re-enter the swapTokens function via its fallback function before the inSwapAndLiquify flag is reset. This allows multiple swaps to occur in a single transaction, draining ETH from the contract. The attacker needs to trigger the swap by selling tokens to the pair when contract has accumulated enough fee tokens.
